title: A category change still reaches AccountingHub
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging if AccountingHub is connected there; otherwise the production test account after the release (look only).
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Rename category A (for example to Inv Check Renamed).
  4. Open AccountingHub's category list for this client.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Category A has its new name.

Step 4:

  • AccountingHub shows the new name, as category changes reach it today.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - runs where AccountingHub is connected: staging if it is, otherwise the production test account after the release
